sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; How Agents Ask for Permission was rejected by publish dedupe, then SAFETY SENTRY was selected from the same unified table.
Read the full 24-page PDF text, including method, dataset construction, threshold formula, Tables 1-7, case studies, limitations, and ethical considerations.
